sam: Proposal: add a PrefetchCoordinator helper to SDKs to reduce cross-process/tab prefetch storms and make onboarding safer. Seen too many teams hit 429s when short-lived creds rotate + prefetch/paging enabled.

leah: love the idea. what would the coordinator do exactly?

sam: high-level: provide an opt-in singleton in each SDK that implements leader election (BroadcastChannel / IPC / Redis), unified cooldown after auth rotate, cancel_inflight_on_rotate option, and a shared token-bucket across workers where possible. It also surfaces x-rate-limit headers into telemetry and exposes a "should_prefetch_now()" gate.

pranav: important to support multiple runtimes: browser (BroadcastChannel + ServiceWorker hints), node (single-process, child processes via IPC or a Redis backend), and mobile (shared storage + leader election). We should keep the default conservative: smaller prefetch windows for browser/mobile, longer cooldowns on auth rotate.

infra-bot: infra note: server already exposes x-ratelimit-* and x-tenant-* headers. If SDK can surface these as metrics we can auto-adapt prefetch aggressiveness. Could be neat to back off before bucket empties.

sam: exactly. design sketch:

- PrefetchCoordinator(config)
  - modes: "local" (in-process), "broadcast" (tabs), "redis" (multi-process), "none"\  - onAuthRotate: pausePrefetch(cooldownMs) + cancelInflight? true|false\  - leaderElection: auto with configurable timeout\  - getPermit(): async boolean -> gate for prefetch loop\  - on429(headers): record and apply exponential cooldown + jitter

leah: API looks good. For node, default to local mode; detect cluster env and enable redis if REDIS_URL present. For browsers, use BroadcastChannel fallback to localStorage if BC unsupported.

pranav: also include recommended presets per runtime: browser {prefetchWindow: 12, maxConcurrent:6, cooldownAfterRotate:800-1500ms}, server {prefetchWindow: 30, maxConcurrent: 12, cooldownAfterRotate:200-600ms}. Document why.

sdk-team: one concern: adding Redis as a default dependency isn't ideal. We can ship an adapter interface and example adapters (redis, in-memory, file-lock), leaving production wiring to integrators. Also ensure the coordinator is small and opt-in.

sam: agreed. opt-in only, plus sampleapp recipes showing how to wire a Redis adapter. Also include a test harness that simulates STS rotation + concurrent tabs/processes and asserts no more than N concurrent requests.

leah: can you sketch a tiny JS example to include in the sampleapp?

sam: sure, quick pseudo:```js
const coord = new PrefetchCoordinator({mode:'broadcast', defaultWindow:12});
coord.start();

async function prefetchLoop(){
  while(await coord.getPermit() && inflight < cfg.max){
    inflight++; client.fetchPage().finally(()=>{ inflight-- });
  }
}

auth.on('refresh', token => coord.onAuthRotate());
```

pranav: nice. next steps: 1) RFC in repo with design + API + presets; 2) implement minimal coordinator in ts-sdk and py-sdk with adapters and sampleapp integration; 3) add devdocs recipe and CI harness. I'll file a tracking ticket and assign.

sdk-team: will prototype JS coordinator and a BroadcastChannel adapter, run it against staging repros. We'll also add telemetry hooks to emit x-rate-limit headers.

leah: add a checklist item to dev onboarding: "enable PrefetchCoordinator in sampleapps" and include recommended runtime presets.

sam: ok creating the RFC draft now and attaching a simple repro harness. tagging @pranav for infra concerns. Thanks! :thumbsup:
